messages.subject: strict measurement invariance
parts:
Hi all,
i have multigroup model with categorical data. I tried to use the measurementivariance function but there was a problem with negative lv variances. I dealt with the problem by fixing variances of some latent variables to the same value in one of two groups which is why I used the lavaan function and fix all parameters manually. 
I successfully applied needed fixation to achieve all steps in measurement invariance testing process, but I´m not able to fix item uniqueness (i.e. item variances). It seems to me that these statistics are not estimated in the model (SE are not computed etc.) and thus I´m not able to fix them to the same values in both groups (also number of df remains unchanged in comparison to the previous step).
Thanks in advance,
Martin
